rv.q: This unique opportunity to see and hear this seldom-produced musical, performed close to the way Rodgers and Hammerstein envisioned their hit musical, shouldn’t be missed.
Music Theater Works does everything right. This show is one to put on your calendar.
It is exactly what you want from the production of a Golden Age musical.
Meantime, if you’ve never seen it onstage, this production is a very fine introduction to one of the best scores in American musical history.
This production, smoothly directed by Sasha Gerritson on a set designed by Shane Cinal, fills the stage at The North Shore Center For Performing Arts in what I might call a perfect way.
Not only was 'this a real nice clambake,' but a spectacular show as well!
This production of Carousel was simply exquisite.

cn.t: Critics praise this Music Theater Works production as an exquisite revival that proves the Rodgers & Hammerstein classic still resonates, with strong performances, contemporary choreography, and a soaring score overcoming concerns about the show's darker themes.
